one_liner: Cloudflare provides content delivery network services, cloud cybersecurity, DDoS mitigation, and domain registration services.
auth_notes: Supports API tokens, Global API keys, and Origin CA keys.
gate_notes: Free tier users can generate API tokens and keys directly from their dashboard profile.
verdict_reason: Cloudflare offers a comprehensive public REST and GraphQL API accessible via self-serve API tokens with robust developer documentation.

extras.rate_limit_note: Rate limits apply per API token/user.

evidence.quote: API Reference | Cloudflare API: Update the AI Security for Apps custom topics of a zone.
Determine if you want a user token or an Account API token. · From the Cloudflare dashboard ↗︎, go to My Profile > API Tokens for user tokens.
